checks.description: Actual compiled preflight uses only readonly target admission; compile excludes write branch and preserves guards.
Distinct signed purpose and mode enforced across preparation/build/arm/composition; write default unchanged.
Confirmed-marker return and uncertain-marker stop tested; documentation preserves physical and full-write pending gates.

constraints.text: Permit preflight_only only with commissioning+trusted-initramfs+recovery-handoff. Reject synthetic/claim_only/fault/selftest combinations that bypass real admission. In the actual compiled preflight exclude all reachable O_RDWR and whole-device/environment transfer write paths, rather than relying on a runtime dry-run boolean. Retain exact board/CID/controller/dev_t, trusted entry/root/source-mount, signed-job freshness, bundle checks and one authenticated claim. Recheck target identity at O_RDONLY open, exact block type/capacity/dev_t, validate both exhausted job-token-bound redundant environment records, and close descriptor on every pass/refusal before finalization. Read-only target admission does not imply marker/stager metadata operations are read-only.

Enforce signed sv08-h616-signed-preflight-v1 for preflight and reject it in ordinary write builds; preflight rejects signed-reimage-v1. Keep otherwise unchanged strict descriptor fields, canonicalization, signature verification, source hashing during physical preparation, expiry/RTC prerequisites and signed descriptor/challenge-bound one-shot receipt validation. Bind purpose/mode and actual binary/initramfs/FIT hashes across builder manifests, preparation/service arming and composition; unsigned labels cannot select authority or override signed purpose. Default write builds/jobs retain their previous format and guards.

Each eventual physical preflight has its own fresh job ID/expiry, isolated durable claim state and ephemeral job/receipt key pairs used only by the reviewed nonwriting artifact. Never reuse, consume or rearm an actual write job/claim. Keep private keys in coordinator-only ignored paths and out of boot artifacts, tests/commits/logs; only verification keys belong in the artifact. No real job/key preparation is part of this offline implementation; physical preparation requires fresh Linux/RTC evidence and existing authority. Claims remain consumed on uncertain response, with no retry or automatic rearming.

Preflight return RB_AUTOBOOT is permitted only after the actual marker was durably consumed AND recovery successfully unmounted; uncertain unlink/fsync/syncfs/unmount/rmdir or any earlier refusal retains POWER_OFF stop. Use a distinct PREFLIGHT_PASS, never full-write PASS or CLAIM_ONLY_PASS. Postconsumption pass/refusal may return only after closing target descriptors and using retained absent-marker original recovery fallback. A returned reboot syscall pauses forever without retry. Do not weaken ordinary full-write finalizer statuses or error stop behavior. Test uncertain-marker/unmount paths, descriptor closure and no relaunch/claim reuse.

Use native actual-C harnesses with captured target-open/close/transfer/finalizer syscalls, valid/corrupt/mismatched copies of both environment records, marker durability/unmount faults and pre/postconsumption refusal cases. Demonstrate compile-time mode rejection and signed cross-purpose rejection through preparation, service arming, build and FIT composition, including unchanged write defaults. Reuse unchanged bulk QEMU, one-shot claim and absent-marker U-Boot fallback evidence at its original scope. Independently verify delivery before any physical commissioning. Tests and artifact receipts do not establish actual H616 boot/reset or recovery response.

Keep one implementer and the eight named files. Document the explicit urh-04 O_RDONLY wording reconciliation without modifying accepted hardware results or declaring their checks passed. urh-04 requires separately reviewed measured entry/identity/marker/raw-environment/recovery-return evidence; original recovery GUI return is not normal-slot health or SSH proof. urh-05 full write/readback remains separate and follows urh-04. Actual p5 metadata staging, boot-policy arming and preflight boot each require exact target/artifact/recovery/preservation evidence, applicable standing owner authorization and immediate independent Sol/high review where uncertainty persists. No hardware action, new dependency/source download, kernel/loader/MCU or production service change is authorized by this decision.

Measure scratch under 512 MiB and aggregate retained artifacts under 64 MiB; no full source/image copies or repeat full-image transfer tests. Record FIT/initramfs size and boot-memory impact against existing load-address/resource constraints. Preserve existing recovery files and rollback artifacts, persistence/idle/heater/8 GB/profile/pinning requirements. Stop on resource or preservation violations; retain documented retirement when supported recovery/update testing replaces this helper.

decision.rationale: Approve offline implementation of the smallest nonwriting physical-handoff preflight under the existing writerless goal. Before: current build_h616_reimage_candidate.py prohibits physical claim_only/fault modes, actual emmc_image_writer.c opens the full target O_RDWR before recovery environment validation, and finish reboots only exact full PASS; this cannot supply the read-only automatic-return evidence required by urh-04. After: a distinct signed-preflight purpose and compile-time nonwriting artifact retain actual authenticated entry/marker/claim/identity checks, admit O_RDONLY capacity/raw-environment reads and return to original recovery only after durable marker consumption and successful unmount. The source proposal explicitly prohibits whole-device WRITE while urh-04 record shorthand prohibits target open; this proposal explicitly reconciles that design wording to permit solely O_RDONLY admission. This bounded clarification preserves the stronger safety purpose and does not mark urh-04 passed. Existing decision 0018/accepted handoff scope authorize bounded offline development; optional features remain paused and no owner product requirement/authority changes. New signed preflight format is a useful purpose boundary rather than a broad job redesign: current job preparation and verifier use signed-reimage-v1, target-policy digest, fixed source/image identity, freshness and descriptor-bound one-shot claims, which must remain default and strict. Source marker consumption already unlinks/fsyncs/syncfs and returns failure if unmount fails, providing a concrete conservative basis for the return gate. Evidence level is reviewed source and accepted offline prior handoff evidence; proposed actual-C/mode/signature checks and physical entry/fallback remain pending. Retained factory/SD/USB recovery supports the existing goal but is no new hardware grant. Independent delivery verification and immediate exact-operation review remain required; no keys, hardware, job preparation or target writes were accessed/performed for this review.

tasks.blocker: FAILED ppf-02 integration at fafb87a02fbc9a25c3e910842af3628e9b00e0fe: scripts/stage_h616_recovery_handoff.py:120-123 calls verify_signed_job with its default write purpose. The actual stage() entry reaches this function before staging or arming. Probe stage-purpose-1 used unchanged commissioning_bundle and signed-stage verification with inert local inputs, no media/services, and expired fixture signatures at controlled time 1500. The default signed-reimage-v1 fixture passed both builder and staging verification; the same policy and correctly signed-preflight-v1 fixture passed builder verification with preflight_only=True but staging refused Stale job or policy mismatch. Thus the intended physical preflight artifact cannot complete the existing supported stage/arm journey. Supplied composition tests model bundle intake and never exercise this staging integration. Obtain a bounded scope amendment for scripts/stage_h616_recovery_handoff.py and relevant staging tests, enforce signed purpose against actual artifact/bundle mode at staging and subsequent journal/arm boundaries, test valid preflight staging plus cross-purpose and unsigned-relabel refusal, preserve all default write checks, then submit new clean revision/evidence for independent verification. Do not bypass staging verification. ppf-01 source/native evidence supports compile-time admission restrictions, absence of reachable whole-device O_RDWR/image/environment transfer paths in preflight, exact board/CID/controller/dev_t and trusted-mount entry checks, postclaim identity recheck, readonly exclusive block open, capacity/dev_t verification, both CRC-checked exhausted job-token environments, and target closure on pass/refusal including close failure. ppf-03 source/native evidence supports distinct PREFLIGHT_PASS; return readiness is assigned only after actual marker consumption succeeds, including unlink/fsync/syncfs/unmount/rmdir; preconsumption/uncertain refusal powers off, postconsumption refusal may reboot through absent-marker recovery fallback, and a returned reboot pauses forever. Existing full-write exact PASS behavior and transfer guard logic remain unchanged. Reviewed supplied 35-test execution log and harness limitations; no broad tests or full-image/QEMU transfer repeated. All seven approved constraints were checked. Fresh isolated physical job IDs/state/ephemeral keys and RTC evidence remain explicit coordinator-only physical prerequisites; no actual job, hardware or service was prepared. Existing claim/bulk-QEMU/absent-marker evidence is reusable only at its original unchanged offline scope. urh-04 measured admission/marker/raw environment/recovery UI return and urh-05 full-write/readback remain pending, with exact-operation independent review and owner authority required. Constraint 7 resource evidence is limited: continuation log reports 66680 KiB RSS, 24 KiB retained logs and 6353 bytes of miniature FIT fixture content; composition models bundle intake/append and uses an inert 22-byte kernel and 25-byte initramfs. Its 1360-byte FIT proves size-accounting machinery only, not actual production FIT/initramfs size or boot-memory impact. Actual artifact/resource comparison against load addresses and preservation limits must remain outstanding; physical boot/relocation observation is a separate later gate. Helper provenance, pinned Monocypher and retirement documentation are retained; no upstream or hardware profile changes. Inspected full historical-base fdacead189de58943aabff7a2483677a23b31fdb..HEAD diff: 35 paths including previously merged policy/workflow files, intentional retired profile deletion, modes and indexed gitlinks. No changed gitlinks or unexpected executable modes; eight indexed gitlinks match upstream-lock.json. Only Monocypher is initialized in this candidate and is clean, so other uninitialized submodules are not claimed exercised. Diff/check and cached/check are clean; changed JSON/TOML parses and local Markdown targets resolve. Proposal/scope/requirement hashes and every submitted source/document hash match candidate; full approved decision matches primary record; submitted evidence equals authoritative task evidence and binds actual clean HEAD. Execution handoff names older precommit HEAD b538f4c; its exact delivered file hashes match the final source and do not establish testing of later policy merges. Candidate is unchanged and clean before/after review. Reviewer is a fresh independent session, with requested feature_verifier_high/GPT-6.1 Sol/high. Effective model/effort/role loading telemetry was unavailable and remains unobserved; prompt/profile configuration is not confirmation. Environment reports danger-full-access and approval never; assigned role boundaries were honored. Coordinator must resolve runtime observation/fallback requirements before treating this as confirmed Sol/high certification. One auxiliary probe used 0.075 seconds reported elapsed and 3657 input bytes; all scratch stays in assigned verification directory, well below 256 MiB; no candidate repairs, record writes, downloads, hardware/credential access, agents or publication.
